$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKF (AIP France, chart dated 2025-08-07): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Figari Sud Corse

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: TWR : HOR annoncés par NOTAM / SKED announced by NOTAM. Aérodrome de FIGARI SUD CORSE, 20114 Figari (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

reportingPoints.name: BF
reportingPoints.location: 1 NM north of the dam of Figari

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.

AD accessibility: for general aviation, PPR before DEP mandatory to operator by E-mail: fsc.ppr@cci.corsica ULM activity: Class 2, 3, 4, and 6 ULM with radio and transponder mode C.; Prohibited activity on SAT, SUN and public HOL between the 1st of June and the 30th of September.; Outside these periods use only after PPR acceptance by the operator.
Crosswind limitation on wet runway: 20 kt.
Wake turbulences during approach: With medium and strong wind (> 15 kt) especially from W/NW sector, strong or very strong turbulences are likely to be encountered in the vicinity of AD.
Turbulences on final: Caution, windshear possibility on final RWY 23.
HS (hot spot): short taxiing distance from parking exit to holding point "C".

On RWY 05 approach, the presence of a photovoltaic roof on an agricultural hangar, about 900 meters before the THR 05 and 70 meters to the right of the runway axis, is likely to cause a dazzle just before the abeam passing hangar.
From June 1st till September 30th RWY patterns must be approved by ATC service.
On final 05 overflight of Mont CALDARELLO (388 ft) covered by PAPI.
Low height patterns: preferential Northward patterns 300 ft minimum reserved for instruction.
Use of turnaround areas (intermediate or end of RWY) is compulsory, for half-turn on RWY.
East of the CTR, recommended transit itinerary northbound and southbound via AS, EAF, EF at 2500 ft AMSL MAX due to IFR activity.
Radio contact not guaranteed with Ajaccio INFO in the East and North East of CTR, due to imperfect VHF coverage.
Without clearance, remain in G class.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with a radar display (see AD 1.0).
FATO operating conditions Compulsory airport handling services: see TXT 03.

Due to stands congestion, obtaining a stand is subject to a request 12 hours before departure, from the AD operator (CCI) by E-mail: fsc.ppr@cci.corsica This procedure does not apply to based helicopters, State and medical helicopters.

FATO use: The FATO is located North-East of the General Aviation Helicopters flying to FIGARI or transiting in the CTR must contact TWR 3 minutes before entering the class D airspace, and fly over the compulsory reporting points.
Radiocommunication failure If failure occurs before receiving the clearance to enter the CTR, the helicopter shall not enter the airspace.

If failure occurs within the CTR: before receiving the clearance to join the traffic pattern: leave the CTR the shortest way,; after receiving the clearance to join the traffic pattern: continue according to the latest clearance.
